statement:
The recorded status of Sector 7 as open is not safe or correct for this case because a stadium event and flight ban are in force today, requiring the flight to be placed on hold.
I have checked the airspace record for Sector 7. Although the record lists the status as open, Sector 7 is subject to a flight ban today due to a stadium event. Because survey flights are strictly prohibited in closed airspace, the flight area for job SV-19 has been placed on **hold**.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "the recorded status of Sector 7 as open is not safe or correct" because a flight ban is in force, contradicting the record.
